verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents RESTful APIs for core directory operations, including bulk operations across users, devices, and groups (docs-3, docs-4, docs-19). Its API 2.0 spec describes graph-traversal GET endpoints that return directly and indirectly bound objects, which covers group and app associations (docs-25), and an official GitHub repo provides API examples. The pack never documents pagination, filtering parameters, or the authentication scheme, and the standard OpenAPI discovery paths returned 404 when probed. Missing for 10: documented pagination, documented filtering/query parameters, clear auth documentation (API keys/OAuth), explicit app-assignment endpoint docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
